risks.risk: The engine may be missing essential components like the alternator, water pump, or oil pump.
risks.proof: A photo showing the engine with all attached accessories.

risks.risk: The engine may have been repaired or rebuilt, which affects its value.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine's identification plate (engine code).

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the engine being cranked over to check for smooth operation.
Photo of the engine identification plate (engine code) to confirm the model and year.
Photo of the engine with all attached accessories to check for completeness.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
